title:
Transforms array of objs to FetchResult based on given fetch spec. Applies limit and offset to the objs.

Also applies the filter of a fetch spec. This filter must be from the {@link UiSdlDataGrid#filterBar} and will only
be applied to `searchable` grid fields. You can add additional fields through the `dataSpec.filter` with fields
surrounded by "*".

Additionally, you must set `fuzzyCount` to true, and not set dataCollectionCount.
name: ApplyFetchSpecToObjsTransform
